title: Byleth Southeast Route Call
prompt:
Byleth crouches with the Blue Lions at the southeast start of the academy mock battle map, drawing a quick route in dirt. Dimitri and Dedue look toward the northeast approach; Ashe, Sylvain, and Ingrid look toward the mid-west thicket line; Annette and Mercedes hold the rear. Byleth points first to the center-west pressure lane, then stops Felix from staring down the northeast opening. The scene establishes tactical restraint before the battle begins. Keep all students youthful and identity-locked.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: cut from field map to Byleth hand gesture. Transition out: cut on Ashe taking the high ground above the first moving enemies. Screen/camera rule: Blue Lions occupy southeast foreground; mid-west pressure is left/deep; northeast trigger zone is right/deep. Audio bridge: Byleth low instruction under whistle and wood weapon noise. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: medium-wide over Byleth shoulder with the map route and distant northeast visible

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: generic crowd, wrong hair colors, war armor, old faces, chaotic battle, text, watermark
transition_in: cut from field map to Byleth hand gesture
transition_out: cut on Ashe taking the high ground above the first moving enemies
screen_direction_rule: Blue Lions occupy southeast foreground; mid-west pressure is left/deep; northeast trigger zone is right/deep
audio_bridge: Byleth low instruction under whistle and wood weapon noise
risk_notes: Must explain why Byleth avoids an early northeast push.
